content.text:
The PR is failing because Aube’s repository moved from `jdx/aube` to `aubepkg/aube`, but Aqua’s registry still expects attestations signed by:

`jdx/aube/.github/workflows/release.yml`

The Aube 2.2.12 artifacts are actually signed by:

`aubepkg/aube/.github/workflows/release.yml`

The refreshed `mise.lock` enabled `provenance = "github-attestations"` for macOS and Windows, exposing that stale registry metadata. Linux x64 passes because its lock entry lacks provenance verification.

The earlier `cargo-edit` error is misleading: mise successfully falls back to `cargo install`. The fatal error is:

> GitHub artifact attestations verification failed … expected `jdx/aube/...`, found `aubepkg/aube/...`

Affected jobs: [macOS build](https://github.com/jdx/hk/actions/runs/34159227250/job/101857365585), [Windows build](https://github.com/jdx/hk/actions/runs/34159227250/job/101857365490), and [macOS ci-other](https://github.com/jdx/hk/actions/runs/34159227250/job/101857365598). The two `final` failures are merely aggregating those failures.

The proper fix is to update [Aqua’s Aube registry entry](https://github.com/aquaproj/aqua-registry/blob/main/pkgs/jdx/aube/registry.yaml) to use `aubepkg/aube` and its release workflow. Removing the new `provenance` fields from `mise.lock` would be a temporary workaround.
